```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\User;
use Faker\Factory as Faker;

class UserSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run()
    {
        $faker = Faker::create();

        for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
            User::create([
                'name' => $faker->name(),
                'email' => $faker->unique()->safeEmail(),
                'password' => bcrypt('secret'),
                'role_id' => 2, // Assuming 'role_id' for regular users is 2
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```
